title: Daily Spread of a Coverage-Type Change in the Early-Duty Month Credit
content:
For a TRICARE Reserve Select plan under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, the change in the early-duty month credit is spread over days: where the change credit covers only part of the month, it is spread over the days that credit covers; where the paid adjustment bill covers only part of the month, it is spread over the days that adjustment covers; otherwise it is spread over every day of the month.

Spreading a change over a number of days means dividing it by that number, giving the change for each day. The days a change credit or an adjustment bill covers are the coverage days it shows; every day of the month means the days the month's bill covers.

| Change | Days it covers (June, 30 days) | Spread over | Change per day (hypothetical) |
|---|---|---|---|
| change credit of 88.24 | 11 | 11 days | 88.24 divided by 11, 8.0218 |
| paid adjustment of 88.24 | 11 | 11 days | 8.0218 |
| change credit of 240.65 | 30 | 30 days | 240.65 divided by 30, 8.0217 |
